story.titleZh: 红牛确认哈贾尔2027赛季留队
story.summaryZh: 红牛车队已确认，伊萨克·哈贾尔将在2027年F1赛季继续留队，担任马克斯·维斯塔潘的队友。
story.originalTitle: Hadjar to remain at Red Bull for 2027
story.summaryEn: Red Bull have confirmed that Isack Hadjar will remain as Max Verstappen's team-mate for the 2027 Formula 1 season.
detailZh: 伊萨克·哈贾尔确认成为马克斯·维斯塔潘在2027年F1赛季的红牛队友，消息在阿塞拜疆大奖赛前公布。
伊萨克·哈贾尔已与红牛续约一年，将在2027年作为马克斯·维斯塔潘的队友迎来第二个赛季；阿塞拜疆大奖赛周四的练习赛将于上午9:30和下午1点在天空体育 F1直播。
伊萨克·哈贾尔承认他不确定新合同续约的细节，也不确定2027年后是否还会留在红牛，但他希望用驾驶表现来说话。
红牛已确认伊萨克·哈贾尔将在2027年F1赛季继续担任马克斯·维斯塔潘的队友。
哈贾尔在今年年初升入红牛，此前他在2025年代表小红牛完成了令人印象深刻的首个赛季，但由于在上个月夏休期间手腕受伤，他缺席了最近三站比赛。
但这位21岁的车手现在已经恢复到可以驾驶的状态，并将在本周末的阿塞拜疆大奖赛回归，正赛于周六举行——在天空体育 F1直播。

红牛上个月已经宣布，四届世界冠军维斯塔潘签署了一份新合同，至少留在车队至2030年底。
“我们非常兴奋能继续与伊萨克同行。自从今年年初加入我们以来，他在赛道上和赛道外都表现出色，尤其是考虑到这只是他第二个F1赛季，这让续约成为一个容易的决定，”红牛车队领队洛朗·梅基斯说道。
“从一开始，伊萨克就全身心融入车队，在工厂里与工程师们分秒必争地研发赛车，总是渴望学习和进步。
“从墨尔本的第一场比赛周末就能看出，他以非凡的沉着应对了这次跃升，并赢得了这个席位。”
不是双关……续约了！红牛用一段搞笑视频宣布哈贾尔合同！
维斯塔潘身边的第二个红牛席位被广泛认为是F1发车格上最难的位置，此前包括皮埃尔·加斯利、亚历克斯·阿尔本、利亚姆·劳森和角田裕毅在内的多位车手都在与这位荷兰人的较量中陷入困境。
但哈贾尔比这些车手更接近维斯塔潘，本赛季甚至有时胜过队友，因此他的席位并未受到质疑。
尽管缺席了最近三个比赛周末，哈贾尔仍在车手积分榜上排名第八，并在红牛和迈凯伦成功上诉加斯利被推翻的超速处罚后，重新获得了摩纳哥大奖赛的领奖台席位。
伊萨克·哈贾尔在红牛上诉后重新回到摩纳哥领奖台，阿尔派对皮埃尔·加斯利在维修区超速的处罚被恢复表示不满。
“他受伤以来的这段时间对伊萨克来说很艰难，但这次续约证明了我们对他有多么信任，我们迫不及待想看到他在赛道上回归，”梅基斯继续说道。
“本赛季我们还有很多目标要实现，但知道车手、工程师和工厂里的每个人都在朝着同一个方向前进，专注且团结，这种感觉很棒。”
“哈贾尔因为手臂和手腕受伤缺席了最近三站。据我了解，那是他在训练中打重沙袋造成的，因为他在训练中会打拳击。
“但他已经康复，本周末将参赛，并且他将在2027年成为马克斯·维斯塔潘的搭档。
“哈贾尔将继续留在红牛。利亚姆·劳森在他缺席期间替补表现得非常好，但没有人对哈贾尔获得继续留队的认可感到意外。
“他可能是自丹尼尔·里卡多多年前离开以来，维斯塔潘最具竞争力的队友。”
哈贾尔补充道：“我非常兴奋能继续与Oracle红牛车队合作。我在八个月前来到这支车队，立刻明白了这个组织的规模和雄心。
“工厂里有那么多才华横溢的人，你会意识到能为这样一支不可思议的车队效力，与像马克斯这样的四届世界冠军并肩作战，是一种特权。
“从我签约的那一刻起，我就决心为车队奉献自己，在洛朗和米尔顿凯恩斯所有人的支持下，我得以证明他们对我的信任是值得的。我不断寻求倾听、学习，并每天进一步推动自己，思考未来的一切。”
皮埃尔·加斯利和伊萨克·哈贾尔参观太阳马戏团，尝试了一些搞笑的特技！
“如果你足够优秀，就能留下”——哈贾尔谈续约和伤愈复出
周三晚些时候在巴库出席车手新闻发布会时，哈贾尔对媒体表示，他对合同续约谈判完全放松——甚至声称自己不知道合同期限有多长。
“我甚至没有谈过这件事。你知道，我让我的人替我谈，”他说。
“我在赛道上谈[判]，就这样。所以是的，非常容易。”
当被问及是否是多年合同时，哈贾尔回答说：“我其实不知道。我不在乎。是的，但是，你知道，如果你足够优秀，就能留下，就这样。”
这位法国人还谈到了他手腕伤势的性质以及康复过程。
“我的手腕外侧有一处小骨折，这是一个相当漫长的过程，”他说。
detailEn: Isack Hadjar confirmed as Max Verstappen's Red Bull team-mate for 2027 Formula 1 season ahead of Azerbaijan Grand Prix

Isack Hadjar has extended his contract at Red Bull for another year and will be Max Verstappen's team-mate for a second season in 2027; watch Thursday's practice sessions for the Azerbaijan Grand Prix at 9.30am and 1pm, live on Sky Sports F1
Isack Hadjar admits he's unsure of the new contract extension details and if he'll remain at Red Bull beyond 2027, but hopes his driving will do the talking
Red Bull have confirmed Isack Hadjar will remain as Max Verstappen's team-mate for the 2027 Formula 1 season.

Hadjar stepped up to Red Bull at the start of this year after an impressive debut campaign with Racing Bulls in 2025 but has missed the last three rounds due to a wrist injury he suffered during last month's summer break.
But the 21-year-old is now fit enough to drive and is back at this weekend's Azerbaijan Grand Prix, which takes place on Saturday - live on Sky Sports F1.

Red Bull had already announced last month that four-time world champion Verstappen signed a new contract to stay at the team until at least the end of 2030.

"We're very excited to continue our journey with Isack. Since joining us at the start of the year, he has been superb on and off track, especially considering this is only his second Formula 1 season, which made extending his contract an easy decision," said Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies.
"From the very beginning, Isack immersed himself in the team, spending every minute at the factory with his engineers to develop the car, always eager to learn and improve.
"You could see from that first weekend in Melbourne that he handled the step up with remarkable composure and had earned his place in this seat."
No pun… extended! Red Bull announce Hadjar contract in hilarious video!

The second Red Bull seat alongside Verstappen is widely regarded as the toughest on the F1 grid after several drivers including Pierre Gasly, Alex Albon, Liam Lawson and Yuki Tsunoda all struggled against the Dutchman.
But, Hadjar has been closer to Verstappen than those drivers and has even got the better of his team-mate at times this season, so his seat has not come under scrutiny.

Despite missing the last three race weekends, Hadjar is still eighth in the Drivers' Championship and reclaimed his Monaco Grand Prix podium after Red Bull and McLaren successfully appealed Gasly's overturned speeding penalties.
Isack Hadjar has been reinstated to the Monaco podium after a Red Bull appeal with Alpine expressing frustration as Pierre Gasly's penalty for speeding in pit lane is restored
"The period since his injury has been a difficult one for Isack, but this extension is a testament to how much we believe in him and we can't wait to see him back out on track," continued Mekies.

"We still have a lot we want to achieve this season, but it's a great feeling to know that the drivers, engineers and everyone back at the factory are all heading in the same direction, committed and together."
"Hadjar has been out for the last three rounds because he damaged his arm and wrist. I understand that was done by hitting a heavy bag in training because he does boxing in training.
"But he has recovered, he is taking part this weekend, and he will be Max Verstappen's partner in 2027.
"Hadjar will be continuing with Red Bull. Liam Lawson deputised very well in his absence but nobody was surprised that Hadjar gets the nod to carry on.
"He has probably been Verstappen's most competitive teammate since Daniel Ricciardo left a few years ago."
Hadjar added: "I am really excited to continue with Oracle Red Bull Racing. I came to this team eight months ago and immediately understood the scale and ambition of this organisation.
"There are so many talented people at the factory, and you're aware of the privilege of driving for such an incredible team alongside a four-time world champion like Max.

"From the moment I signed, I set out to dedicate myself to the team, and with the support of Laurent and everyone in Milton Keynes, I've been able to justify the faith they've had in me. I'm constantly looking to listen, learn and push myself further every single day about what lies ahead."
Pierre Gasly and Isack Hadjar visit Cirque Du Soleil to try their hand at some hilarious stunts!
'If you're good, you stay' - Hadjar on extended deal and injury return

Speaking to the media later on Wednesday in Baku when appearing in the Drivers' Press Conference, Hadjar said he had been completely relaxed about the contract renewal discussions - even claiming he did not know how long the deal was for.
"I didn't even talk about it. You know, I let my people do the talking for me," he said.
"I do it [the talking] on the track and that's about it. So yeah, it was very easy."
And asked whether it was a mufti-year term, Hadjar replied: "I actually don't know. I don't care. Yeah, but, you know, if you're good, you stay, and that's it."
The Frenchman also spoke about the nature of his wrist injury and how his rehabilitation had gone.
"I have a small fracture outside of the wrist and it's just quite a long process," he said.

红牛车手马克斯·维斯塔潘与梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔将在拉斯维加斯正赛头排发车；拉塞尔在第三节练习碰撞后抨击了维斯塔潘；周日凌晨4点观看正赛（2点30分开始赛前节目），天空体育F1频道和主赛事频道直播。
乔治·拉塞尔回应了拉斯维加斯大奖赛第三节练习中与马克斯·维斯塔潘的碰撞，指责这位红牛车手“坑害”对手。
乔治·拉塞尔在拉斯维加斯大奖赛第三节练习中与马克斯·维斯塔潘发生碰撞后，对维斯塔潘进行了严厉批评，而两人接下来将在正赛头排一起发车。
这两人近年来在赛道上曾有过摩擦，在第三节练习赛中因争夺赛道位置而发生车轮碰撞。
维斯塔潘先在沿拉斯维加斯大道驶向14号弯的路段超越拉塞尔，随后梅赛德斯赛车在刹车区从红牛赛车内侧反超，两车车轮发生擦碰。

排位赛后，当被问及干事对维斯塔潘的处罚时，拉塞尔表示“警告就够了”，随后对这位红牛对手的做法进行了严厉批评。
拉塞尔对天空体育意大利台表示：“规则里没有任何条款说不能超越正在开始飞驰圈的人，但当你这么做时，你就是在坑害这个人，而他每周都这样对待许多车手，所有人都接受了。”
“我不会就这样接受别人这样坑害我，还表现得好像他们比所有人都更大更强。总得有人站出来对抗那家伙。”
拉塞尔关于想要“站出来对抗”维斯塔潘的言论，与他此前在2024年卡塔尔大奖赛排位赛事件后所说的话如出一辙。
在那次冲突之后，两人当面以及通过采访互相讥讽；当时维斯塔潘因为在Q3阻挡拉塞尔被罚退后一位发车，而这位梅赛德斯车手随后在下一周阿布扎比站比赛前对对手发起了猛烈抨击。
回到2024年，克雷格·斯莱特更仔细地审视了卡塔尔站罚退事件的余波如何在乔治·拉塞尔和马克斯·维斯塔潘之间升级。
周六，两人在排位赛后新闻发布会上并排而坐时，都被问及最后一次练习赛中的事件，以及关于不打扰即将开始飞驰圈的对手的“君子协定”是否存在任何困惑。
维斯塔潘说“什么都没发生”，而拉塞尔说“没有困惑，我认为这相当清楚”。
评论员们如何看待这次冲突和拉塞尔的言论？
天空体育F1频道的雅克·维伦纽夫谈到事件本身时说：“看起来有趣又刺激！但我们希望在正赛中看到这种情况，而不是在自由练习中。没有必要。”
“一旦你失去了赛道位置，那对你不利。如果你是乔治，你被超越了，这是练习赛。好吧，你拿不回来，你失去了位置，继续前进。”
“那是一个完全没有必要的风险。你不想和马克斯成为敌人。”
回顾红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘与梅赛德斯车队的乔治·拉塞尔之间一些最激烈的交锋。
在听到拉塞尔排位赛后的言论后，天空体育F1频道的杰米·查德威克表示：“乔治说他会对抗马克斯，我喜欢这一点。这非常让人想起我们在卡塔尔看到的情况。”
“我们知道乔治永远不会向马克斯让步。我认为马克斯确实会尝试在这种事情上碰运气，这就是为什么他能够让自己处于有利位置。这也来自维修区墙上的指令，他们告诉他要穿过车流，奋力争取干净空气，他很有侵略性，确实会把别人挤开。大多数人都会对此让步，然后像利亚姆·劳森（在墨西哥城大奖赛）这样的人出现，不让步，结果惹上了大车队的麻烦。”
“我挺喜欢乔治对抗他这一点，因为马克斯是故意这么做的，他就是那样驾驶的。对此有值得肯定的一面，但也有需要抗争的一面。”

两人如今将同在前排发车，驶向拉斯维加斯首个弯道的短距离冲刺，维伦纽夫补充道：“两人之间毫无情面可言，这对明天发车前的局面倒是好事！那会让比赛更刺激。”
“他确实不该超越一个即将开始飞驰圈的人，但那个人怎么知道你要开始飞驰圈呢？这是一回事，而且也许你自己也正要开始自己的飞驰圈。
“所以归根结底，这很难判断。”

detailEn: George Russell hits out at Max Verstappen after Las Vegas GP clash and says 'somebody's got to stand up to that guy'

Red Bull's Max Verstappen and Mercedes' George Russell to start on front row of Las Vegas grid; Russell hit out at Verstappen after final practice collision; watch Sunday's race at 4am (build-up from 2.30am), live on Sky Sports F1 and Main Event
George Russell reacted to the collision with Max Verstappen in final practice at the Las Vegas Grand Prix, accusing the Red Bull driver of of 'screwing' his rivals over

George Russell launched a scathing criticism of Max Verstappen after a collision between the pair in final practice at the Las Vegas Grand Prix ahead of a race they will now start on the front row together.
​​​The pair, who have had run-ins in the past on track in recent years, clashed wheels in final practice as they fought over track position.
Verstappen first overtook Russell on the run down The Strip to Turn 14 before the Mercedes went back down the inside of the Red Bull in the braking zone, with the two cars brushing wheels.

Stewards investigated the incident and issued a warning to Verstappen, ruling he had been "driving erratically" under braking into the corner once ahead of the Mercedes.

The pair went on to qualify second and third, which becomes first and second on the grid for Sunday's race at 4am, live on Sky Sports F1, due to Q3 pacesetter Kimi Antonelli's five-place grid penalty.
George Russell and Max Verstappen collided with one another during final practice at the Las Vegas Grand Prix
Asked after qualifying about the sanction issued to Verstappen by stewards, Russell said "a warning was fine" before going on to issue a withering rebuke of his Red Bull rival's approach.

Russell told Sky Italy: "There's nothing in the rules to say you cannot overtake someone who is starting a lap but when you do this, you are screwing this person over and he does this week in, week out with many drivers and everybody accepts it.
"I'm not just going to accept somebody to screw me over like this and walk around like they're bigger and better than everyone else. Somebody's got to stand up to that guy."
Russell's comments about wanting to "stand up to" Verstappen echoed those he made following an incident in qualifying at the 2024 Qatar Grand Prix.

The pair traded barbs in person and via interviews after that clash, when Verstappen was given a one-place grid drop for impeding Russell in Q3, with the Mercedes driver then launching an explosive attack on his rival ahead of the following week's race in Abu Dhabi.
Back in 2024, Craig Slater took a closer look at how the Qatar penalty fallout escalated between George Russell and Max Verstappen

On Saturday, the pair were both asked when sitting next to each other in the post-qualifying press conference about the final practice incident and whether there had any confusion about the 'gentleman's agreement' regarding not disturbing a rival who was about to start a flying lap.
Verstappen said "nothing happened", while Russell said there was "no confusion, I think it was pretty clear".
What did the pundits make of the clash and Russell's comments?
Sky Sports F1's Jacques Villeneuve said of the incident itself: "Fun and exciting to watch! But we want to see this in the race, not in free practice. Unnecessary.
"Once you've lost your track position, too bad for you. If you're George, you got overtaken, it's practice. OK, you don't get it back, you lost your position and move on.
"That was a completely unnecessary risk. You don't want to make an enemy of Max."
A look back at some of the most heated clashes between Red Bull's Max Verstappen and Mercedes' George Russell
Speaking after hearing Russell's post-qualifying comments, Sky Sports F1's Jamie Chadwick said: "George saying he'll stand up to Max, I like that. It's very reminiscent of what we saw in Qatar.

"With George we know he's never going to give to Max. I think Max does try his luck with that kind of thing and that is why he is able to find himself in good positions. It comes also from the pit wall, who are telling him to push through the traffic and fight his way to get clear air, and he's aggressive and he does bully people out of the way. Most people do give in to that and then someone like Liam Lawson [at the Mexico City GP] comes along, doesn't, and gets in trouble from the big team.

"I quite like the fact that George is standing up to him because Max does it intentionally, he drives like that. There is something good to be said for that, but there's also something that needs to be fought against."
Highlights from qualifying for the 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix

With the pair now starting together on the front row for the short run to Las Vegas' first corner, Villeneuve added: "No love lost there, so that's good before the start for tomorrow! That will make it exciting.

"He shouldn't overtake someone who is about to start his lap, true, but how does that person know you're about to start your lap? That's one thing, and maybe you're about to start your own lap yourself.
"So that's a difficult one to judge, ultimately."
